privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Nikkozan Chuzenji Tachiki Kannon ("the temple") is committed to protecting the personal information of our visitors.
privacy.collectionText: When making a prayer service reservation, submitting an application, or making an inquiry, we may ask you to provide personal information such as your name, address, phone number, and email address.
privacy.purpose1: To confirm and provide information about prayer service and experience reservations
privacy.purpose3: To mail omamori charms, ofuda talismans, and similar items
privacy.thirdPartyText: Except as required by law, the temple will not disclose personal information to third parties without the individual's consent.
privacy.managementText: The temple takes appropriate security measures to prevent the leakage, loss, or damage of collected personal information.
privacy.disclosureText: If you wish to have your personal information disclosed, corrected, or deleted, please contact us using the information below. We will respond appropriately after verifying your identity.
privacy.cookieText: This site may use cookies to improve our services. You can disable cookies through your browser settings, though some features may become unavailable as a result.
privacy.changesText: The temple may revise this policy as needed. Any revised policy takes effect once posted on this site.

prayerMailApply.title: Apply by Mail
prayerMailApply.subtitle: Prayer Service
prayerMailApply.intro: If visiting in person is difficult, you may apply for a prayer service through our online shop or by registered mail.
prayerMailApply.chooseMethod: Please choose how you'd like to apply
prayerMailApply.ecDesc: You can apply through our online shop.
prayerMailApply.ecModalText: If applying this way, please be sure to note your desired prayer type (General Prayer / Safe Childbirth Prayer / Shichi-Go-San Prayer / Other) in the order notes field.
prayerMailApply.cashDesc: Fill out the application form and send it by registered mail with cash enclosed.
prayerMailApply.cashModalTitle: Steps to Apply by Registered Mail
prayerMailApply.cashStep1: Purchase a registered mail (genkin-kakitome) envelope at the post office
prayerMailApply.cashStep2: Download the application form and fill in the required details
prayerMailApply.cashStep3: Enclose the prayer offering fee in the cash envelope and mail it to Tachiki Kannon
prayerMailApply.cashStep4: After the prayer is performed, we will mail the ofuda tablet cash-on-delivery
prayerMailApply.cashAddress: 2578 Chugushi, Nikko, Tochigi 321-1661, Japan — Nikkozan Chuzenji Tachiki Kannon
prayerMailApply.phoneHours: Hours: within visiting hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM)
